name: ACT
inputs: Multi-view RGB and joint state
architecture: Visual encoder and transformer CVAE
action_representation: Joint-position action chunks
training: Action reconstruction plus KL regularization
data: Task-specific teleoperation demonstrations
inference: Zero latent at deployment; repeatedly predict chunks and combine overlapping predictions
contribution: Reduce effective imitation horizon on low-cost bimanual hardware
limitations: Limited demonstration support; no built-in language foundation model or guaranteed contact-force reasoning
openness: Code and hardware design available

name: Diffusion Policy
inputs: Recent visual observations and robot state
architecture: Conditional temporal diffusion network
action_representation: Continuous future action sequence
training: Denoising / score learning on expert actions
data: Robot manipulation demonstration benchmarks
inference: Iterative denoising; execute a prefix and re-observe
contribution: Model multimodal action distributions with receding-horizon feedback
limitations: Sampling cost and data coverage remain limiting; original model is not automatically a web-pretrained VLA
openness: Code and training materials available

name: RT-1
inputs: Short image history and language instruction
architecture: EfficientNet with FiLM, TokenLearner, transformer
action_representation: Discretized arm/base controls and termination mode
training: Supervised action-token prediction
data: Over 130k episodes, over 700 tasks, 13 robots
inference: 3 Hz policy loop with termination condition
contribution: Demonstrated scalable multitask robot behavior cloning
limitations: Mostly restricted robot/task distribution; language conditioning is not equivalent to large VLM reasoning
openness: Code and data links public

name: RT-2
inputs: RGB and task text
architecture: Pretrained PaLI-X or PaLM-E adapted to robot control
action_representation: Robot action bins serialized as text tokens
training: Co-fine-tuning robot trajectories and web vision-language tasks
data: Robot actions plus web VLM corpora
inference: Autoregressively generate and detokenize actions, then re-observe
contribution: Transfer semantic web knowledge directly into action selection
limitations: New semantic concepts do not imply new low-level motor skills; large decoder adds latency
openness: Research report; complete trained model not openly reproduced

name: RT-X / Open X-Embodiment
inputs: Robot images and language across platforms
architecture: RT-1-X and RT-2-X retain their respective base architectures
action_representation: Standardized action interfaces with dataset-specific semantics
training: Multirobot supervised policy learning
data: Pooled data from 22 robot embodiments in initial report
inference: Decode to target robot interface within a feedback loop
contribution: Established positive transfer from heterogeneous robot experience
limitations: Common file schema does not ensure identical physics, control frequency, or coordinates
openness: Dataset/code resources; openness differs between RT variants

name: Octo
inputs: Language or goal image; flexible observation streams
architecture: Modular tokenizers, transformer and diffusion action head
action_representation: Continuous action chunks; replaceable action heads
training: Robot pretraining plus efficient domain fine-tuning
data: 800k Open X-Embodiment trajectories
inference: Sample action chunk, execute prefix, replan
contribution: Flexible sensors and action spaces without requiring a giant language decoder
limitations: Needs adaptation for new interfaces; robot pretraining does not by itself give broad conversational reasoning
openness: Open code and checkpoints

name: OpenVLA
inputs: Robot image and instruction
architecture: DINOv2/SigLIP visual features with Llama 2 language backbone
action_representation: Discretized robot action tokens
training: Action-token cross-entropy and optional efficient fine-tuning
data: 970k real robot demonstrations; 7B model
inference: Sequential action-token decoding and robot feedback
contribution: Accessible VLA pretraining and adaptation reference
limitations: Original decoder is expensive for high-frequency chunks; new hardware generally requires tuning
openness: Code and weights available; component licenses apply

name: OpenVLA-OFT
inputs: Images, instruction and configurable robot state
architecture: OpenVLA adapted for parallel chunk prediction
action_representation: Continuous action chunks
training: L1 regression with parallel decoding and chunking
data: Task-adaptation data; LIBERO and real ALOHA evaluations
inference: Predict multiple actions in parallel; update observations during control
contribution: Shows fine-tuning/output design can dominate practical speed and success
limitations: L1 favors a conditional median; multimodal behavior and language grounding need separate checks
openness: Code and checkpoints public

name: pi0
inputs: Multi-view images, text, proprioception and noisy actions
architecture: PaliGemma 3B plus roughly 300M robot action expert
action_representation: Continuous chunks of 50 actions in the reported setup
training: Conditional flow matching; broad pretraining then dexterous post-training
data: Private multirobot data mixed with open robot datasets
inference: Cache observation prefix; integrate action vector field and execute chunks
contribution: Combine semantic VLM features with continuous dexterous control
limitations: Base generality and specialist performance are different settings; dataset mixture is not fully open
openness: openpi releases code and selected weights

name: FAST / pi0-FAST
inputs: Normalized continuous action chunks during tokenization; image/text at policy time
architecture: DCT, quantization and BPE tokenizer with autoregressive policy
action_representation: Compressed frequency-domain action tokens
training: Next-token learning on compressed robot sequences
data: Robot trajectories including dexterous tasks and DROID adaptation
inference: Generate tokens; inverse transform to continuous chunks
contribution: Removes redundancy in high-frequency action sequences
limitations: Token compression and training speed do not guarantee low closed-loop latency; quantization is a design tradeoff
openness: Tokenizer and pi0-FAST models available

name: pi0.5 / knowledge insulation
inputs: Images, task/subtask text and robot state
architecture: PaliGemma VLM plus continuous action expert and token objectives
action_representation: Language subtasks; discrete auxiliary actions; continuous motor chunks
training: Heterogeneous co-training; KI blocks expert gradients while token/VLM objectives train backbone
data: Multirobot trajectories, semantic/subtask annotations and nonrobot VLM data
inference: High-level subtask prediction conditions faster low-level action generation
contribution: Improve open-environment generalization while preserving semantic features
limitations: KI is not simply freezing the VLM; original paper and open implementation differ in supported heads
openness: openpi code and pi0.5 flow checkpoints available

name: pi0.6
inputs: Images, robot state, text and heterogeneous prompt metadata
architecture: Gemma 3 4B backbone plus about 860M action expert
action_representation: Discrete outputs and continuous action chunks
training: Supervised VLA training with revised architecture and data
data: Expanded heterogeneous robot training data; full corpus undisclosed
inference: Predict subtasks and conditional motor chunks
contribution: Refinement of pi0.5 and starting point for real-world RL
limitations: Architecture change is distinct from RECAP improvement; do not call the base model RL-trained
openness: Model card available; inspected openpi does not list this checkpoint

name: pi-star-0.6 / RECAP
inputs: pi0.6 observations with desired advantage condition
architecture: pi0.6 policy plus learned value function during training
action_representation: Advantage-conditioned continuous robot actions
training: Offline RL, demonstrations, corrective takeovers and autonomous reward-labeled rollouts
data: Generalist data and task-specific on-robot experience
inference: Condition on high advantage at execution; value learning improves next policy iteration
contribution: Improve both successful completions per hour and reliability
limitations: Reward and intervention infrastructure is task-specific; results do not establish unconstrained autonomous self-improvement
openness: Paper and model details; complete RL pipeline/data not publicly reproducible

name: MEM / pi0.6-MEM
inputs: Video history, language memory, current observations and state
architecture: Compressed short-term visual encoder plus long-term textual state
action_representation: Subtasks and continuous action chunks from augmented VLA
training: Train with robot/nonrobot images and video plus task history
data: Diverse robot and nonrobot corpus; evaluated memory-dependent tasks
inference: Update memory and condition subsequent decisions on prior attempts
contribution: Address partial observability and repeated failed strategies
limitations: Task memory is not lifelong retention; summaries can lose or corrupt state
openness: Research page/paper; no complete public checkpoint confirmed

name: pi0.7
inputs: Current/history observations, task/subtask, quality/speed metadata, optional visual subgoals
architecture: pi0.6 architecture plus MEM; Gemma 3 4B and 860M flow expert
action_representation: Continuous actions conditioned on varied multimodal prompts
training: Conditioned learning from diverse-quality data; absorb RL specialist experience
data: Multirobot, human and autonomous data; exact mixture not fully released
inference: High-level policy and optional BAGEL-based world model generate subgoals; VLA acts and updates memory
contribution: Compositional skill reuse through better conditioning rather than a wholly new backbone
limitations: Some tasks require language coaching or adapted high-level policy; broad generality remains author-evaluated
openness: Technical report; inspected openpi does not list public pi0.7 weights

name: SmolVLA
inputs: Images, language and projected robot state
architecture: Truncated SmolVLM2 with approximately 100M action expert; 450M total
action_representation: Continuous action chunks
training: Freeze VLM and learn flow-matching expert
data: LeRobot community demonstrations and target fine-tuning
inference: Iterative flow generation; synchronous and asynchronous scheduling evaluated separately
contribution: Lower model footprint and accessible robot-policy experimentation
limitations: Community/task coverage and execution schedule affect results; no universal real-time frequency
openness: Open code, checkpoints and community datasets

name: GR00T N1
inputs: Images, language and embodiment-specific state
architecture: Eagle VLM features cross-attended by flow DiT; embodiment MLPs
action_representation: Continuous chunks, with robot and learned latent action targets
training: Flow matching across real, simulated, neural-generated and human data
data: Multirobot demonstrations, simulation, human videos
inference: Action expert samples chunks; hardware controller tracks commands
contribution: Connect semantic perception to multiple embodiments and synthetic-data pipelines
limitations: System 2 naming does not prove explicit planning; transfer still needs target post-training
openness: Open weights/code with release-specific terms

name: GR00T N1.5
inputs: Images, text, state and noised actions
architecture: Frozen Eagle 2.5-derived VLM and DiT
action_representation: Continuous flow actions with future-feature auxiliary target
training: Flow loss plus FLARE latent future alignment
data: N1 mixture expanded with DreamGen and other robot sources
inference: Cross-attended chunk generation and target adaptation
contribution: Stronger language grounding; learn useful future representation from videos
limitations: New verbs supplied through synthetic trajectories are trained skills, not unrestricted zero-shot transfer
openness: Versioned code and model cards available

name: GR00T N1.6
inputs: Flexible-resolution images, language and robot state
architecture: Cosmos-2B internal VLM variant; 32-layer DiT; top VLM layers unfrozen
action_representation: Mostly state-relative action chunks
training: Mixed pretraining and regularized target post-training
data: Additional YAM, AgiBot, BEHAVIOR and Unitree G1 data
inference: Chunk generation with optional real-time chunking
contribution: Expanded embodiments and improved motion modeling
limitations: Relative actions can accumulate errors; language/OOD generalization remains explicitly unresolved
openness: Code and model-card releases available

name: GR00T N1.7
inputs: Images, instruction and robot state
architecture: Cosmos-Reason2-2B / Qwen3-VL backbone plus action DiT; 3B checkpoint
action_representation: Continuous robot action chunks
training: Generalist pretraining and robot-specific post-training
data: Vendor reports around 32k hours real/human and 8k simulated data
inference: ONNX/TensorRT export and robot runtime support
contribution: Stronger backbone and end-to-end deployment tooling
limitations: Availability is not field reliability; earlier FAQ and newer GA repository differ
openness: Official repository labels N1.7 GA. License section: code Apache 2.0; model weights NVIDIA Open Model License. The README also contains a broader Apache 2.0 commercialization statement; do not conflate code and weight terms, and check the specific checkpoint.

name: Gemini Robotics / ER
inputs: VLA: images, instructions and robot state; ER: multimodal context
architecture: Gemini-based action model alongside separate embodied reasoning VLM
action_representation: VLA motor commands; ER plans, spatial outputs and tool calls
training: Robot adaptation of multimodal pretrained models; full recipe undisclosed
data: Web multimodal and robot data
inference: ER can plan; VLA repeatedly grounds observations into movement
contribution: Clear separation between physical reasoning and executable control
limitations: ER alone is not a motor policy; complete model/data access limited
openness: Research report and partner access; no open full VLA weights

name: Gemini Robotics 1.5 / ER 1.5
inputs: Multirobot visual/state observations, instructions and tool context
architecture: Multi-embodiment VLA with Motion Transfer; separate ER orchestration
action_representation: Motor actions interleaved with language reasoning; ER task plans
training: Cross-embodiment training and thinking behavior; exact full recipe undisclosed
data: ALOHA, bimanual Franka, Apollo and web text/image/video
inference: ER calls tools and dispatches subtasks; VLA reasons and acts with feedback
contribution: Motion transfer and agentic multi-step behavior
limitations: Some long-horizon Franka results include additional post-training; reasoning text is not a safety proof
openness: ER API availability; VLA restricted to partners at release

name: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6
inputs: Text, images, audio and video
architecture: Gemini 3.0 Flash-derived reasoning model
action_representation: Text/spatial representations and function calls, not direct torques
training: Gemini training plus embodied reasoning data; exact objective undisclosed
data: General multimodal and specialized embodied reasoning datasets
inference: Infer geometry/progress, invoke tools or downstream policies
contribution: Better instrument reading, pointing and multiview success estimation
limitations: Success-detector mistakes propagate; single/multiview benchmark examples differ
openness: API/model card; closed weights

name: Gemini Robotics 2
inputs: Visual observations, language and robot state
architecture: Next-generation multi-embodiment Gemini VLA; internal details undisclosed
action_representation: Whole-body and dexterous motor commands
training: Robot foundation-model training; full losses and corpus not disclosed
data: Vendor robot experiments across Apollo and bimanual platforms
inference: Execute whole-body tasks under observation feedback and ER coordination
contribution: Extend control from upper-body manipulation to whole-body tasks
limitations: Author reports remaining speed and multifinger failures; no public full training recipe
openness: Early-access partner VLA

name: Gemini Robotics ER 2
inputs: Multimodal scene and task context
architecture: Gemini 3.5 Flash-derived embodied reasoning model
action_representation: Plans, text, coordination and tool calls
training: Gemini 3.5 data plus specialized embodied reasoning data
data: Undisclosed complete corpus
inference: Orchestrate robot activities and coordinate multiple robots
contribution: Agentic coordination complements whole-body VLA
limitations: Reasoning benchmark gains do not establish motor reliability
openness: AI Studio access; enterprise private preview stated at launch

name: Gemini Robotics On-Device 2
inputs: Images, instruction and numerical proprioception
architecture: Robotics 1.5 technology combined with on-device Gemma
action_representation: Numerical robot action outputs
training: Robot sensor/action and multimodal training; detailed losses undisclosed
data: Proprietary training corpus; adaptation data for new embodiment
inference: Run local inference and act under sensor feedback
contribution: Local deployment and faster new-embodiment adaptation
limitations: On-device does not mean open weights; adaptation hours are data requirements, not a universal deployment guarantee
openness: Early-access partner model

name: RDT-1B
inputs: Language, multiview images, state and control frequency
architecture: Scalable 1.2B robotics diffusion transformer
action_representation: Physically interpretable unified continuous action space
training: Denoising pretraining followed by bimanual fine-tuning
data: Large multirobot collection and over 6k bimanual episodes
inference: Denoise action chunks and execute with feedback
contribution: Explicit action semantics support heterogeneous robot transfer
limitations: Unified slots still require correct units, masks and robot-specific mapping; iterative sampling costs
openness: Code and weights available

name: UniVLA (OpenDriveLab)
inputs: Video frame pairs and task language for learning; observation and language for policy
architecture: Task-conditioned VQ-VAE in DINO feature space; VLA plus lightweight action decoder
action_representation: Embodiment-agnostic latent action tokens decoded to physical controls
training: Latent-action learning, policy pretraining and robot decoder adaptation
data: Cross-embodiment OpenX and human Ego4D videos
inference: Predict latent action, decode for target robot, re-observe
contribution: Use videos lacking robot action labels while suppressing task-irrelevant motion
limitations: Latent action abstraction may omit contact/control detail; decoder still needs real robot supervision
openness: Code and checkpoints public

name: UniVLA (BAAI)
inputs: Image/video, language and action sequences
architecture: Emu3-based autoregressive multimodal model
action_representation: Discrete visual, language and action tokens
training: World-model post-training and downstream policy learning
data: Video and robot benchmark data
inference: Generate action tokens using learned temporal representations
contribution: Unify visual prediction and action learning in one token framework
limitations: Distinct from OpenDriveLab UniVLA; inference budgets and benchmark variants matter
openness: Code, models and training paths available

name: X-VLA
inputs: Fixed and wrist images, language, state, dataset/embodiment identity
architecture: Florence-Large vision-language stream, separate auxiliary vision, soft-prompted transformer
action_representation: Continuous action chunks with domain input/output projections
training: Flow matching with embodiment-specific soft prompts and balanced heterogeneous data
data: Multiple robot datasets and simulation/real adaptation settings
inference: Condition action generation on target prompt and robot interface
contribution: Separate shared skills from embodiment-specific conditioning efficiently
limitations: Soft prompts require valid domain identity/adaptation; not automatic support for arbitrary hardware
openness: Code and checkpoints linked from project

name: LingBot-VLA 2.0
inputs: Images, text, canonical robot state
architecture: Qwen3-VL-based model, sparse MoE action expert and semantic/depth future distillation
action_representation: 55-dimensional canonical state/action including four reserved slots
training: Action learning plus dual-query future-feature/depth supervision; action-loss choices ablated
data: 60k curated hours: 50k robot from 20 configurations and 10k human ego
inference: Predict physical actions with target embodiment mapping and feedback
contribution: Combine scaling, wider body action coverage and predictive priors
limitations: Nine GM-100 tasks are not the whole benchmark; OOD full-task success remains low in some tests
openness: 6B native-depth checkpoint and code released

name: Real-Time Chunking (RTC)
inputs: Current observations plus already committed action prefix
architecture: Inpainting/conditioning procedure around an existing flow policy
action_representation: Continuous chunks with a fixed prefix
training: Original approach can operate without retraining the backbone
data: Existing pretrained policy; evaluate delayed/asynchronous execution
inference: Compute next chunk while executing current actions; preserve prefix continuity
contribution: Reduce pauses and discontinuities from delayed large-model inference
limitations: Requires latency budgeting; not a fix for incorrect goals or unobserved collisions
openness: Research algorithm; integrations available in robot stacks
